description: He wears a reddish-brown woven open-front knee-length cote over a cream linen shirt and long cream underlayer, with pale gold geometric embroidery along the collar, front borders, cuffs and hem. A matching red-brown mantle crosses the upper chest, held by a round brooch, and has narrow worked edging. A decorated brown leather belt with a round buckle and long hanging end secures the cote. Brown trousers and tall brown leather boots complete the outfit. No headgear, armor or weapons appear.
